subject: Re: Vendr profile attribute reconciliation and ownership
messages:
From: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@brightleaf.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr onboarding: attribute mapping for BrightLeaf

Hi Soojin / Laura,

We kicked off Vendr onboarding yesterday and pulled a profile export — there are a handful of attributes the portal expects that don't map cleanly to our questionnaire. Examples: data_residency vs. country_of_storage, kms_encrypted vs. kms_status, and evidence_link vs. proof_url.

Can your team confirm who owns each attribute on Redwood's side so we can populate the portal without introducing stale or duplicate fields? I've attached the Vendr export (vendr_field_export.csv) and flagged the rows we couldn't map.

High level ask:
- Quick owner assignment for the 10 flagged fields
- A short reconciliation (1–2 lines) per attribute explaining how BrightLeaf's terminology should translate into Vendr fields

We're hoping to close this by end of week so Vendr can validate the profile and send the CAIQ stub. If it helps we can hop on a 30-minute screen-share — we are available tomorrow 9–11am and Thursday afternoon.

Thanks,
Hannah Cole
Senior Security Program Manager | BrightLeaf Payments
attachments: vendr_field_export.csv (csv, 23KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: attribute mapping for BrightLeaf

Hi Hannah — thanks for the export and the clear flags.

Short answer: we can do owner assignments and produce a reconciliation doc. Suggested plan:
1) We populate the attached reconciliation-template.xlsx with our canonical field name, the Vendr field, and the internal owner (data classification, security, or platform).
2) Rishi will review the encryption/KMS rows and confirm whether kms_encrypted maps to our KMS status bucket or needs a custom enum.
3) Quick 30m session to validate the mapping and hand the file back to you for upload.

Proposed times: Wednesday 9:30–10:00am PT or Thursday 1:30–2:00pm PT. Tell me which works and we will send a calendar invite.

I'll start filling the template with the obvious matches and tag anything ambiguous with "action: review".

Warmly,
- Soojin
Soojin Lee
Manager, Vendor Security & Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Immediate next steps for our side before the call:
- I'll complete the obvious mappings in the reconciliation-template.xlsx and mark "action: rishi" on the KMS rows.
- Marissa will add SIG/SOC2 crosswalk notes for any attribute that implies a control.
- Rishi please confirm whether we publish a single canonical value for kms_status or expose the enum Vendr expects (e.g., "managed_kms" vs "customer_managed_kms").

Thanks — looking forward.
